recommendedTextbook.title: Physical and Health Education for Junior Secondary Schools Book 2
recommendedTextbook.author: A. O. Folawiyo, B. A. Miller, S. M. Oloyede
recommendedTextbook.approvedBy: NERDC & Lagos State Ministry of Basic Education

topics.topic: Ball Games: Football Skills, Rules and Officials
subtopics: Fundamental skills: Dribbling, passing (push pass, lofted pass), trapping/control, heading, shooting
Goalkeeping skills: Catching, punching, diving, distribution
FIFA Laws of the Game: Offside rule, direct/indirect free kicks, fouls and misconduct, duties of referee and assistant referees
objectives: Demonstrate controlled instep push passing and ball cushioning
Explain the FIFA offside rule using tactical pitch diagrams
List 5 yellow-card and 3 red-card professional offenses

topics.topic: Ball Games: Basketball Skills and Court Dimensions
subtopics: Basketball fundamentals: Chest pass, bounce pass, overhead pass, dribbling (high vs low), lay-up shot, jump shot
Court specifications: Backboard, hoop height (10ft), 3-point arc, free throw line
Basic FIBA rules: Traveling, double dribble, 24-second shot clock, personal fouls
objectives: Execute a two-step right-handed lay-up shot off the backboard backboard square
Draw and dimension a standard basketball court with key marking lines
Distinguish technical fouls from intentional personal fouls

topics.topic: Physical Fitness Components and Testing Protocols
subtopics: Health-related components: Cardiovascular endurance, muscular strength, muscular endurance, flexibility, body composition
Skill-related components: Agility, balance, coordination, power, reaction time, speed
Standard fitness tests: Shuttle run (agility), sit-and-reach (flexibility), Harvard step test
objectives: Distinguish health-related from skill-related physical fitness
Measure resting pulse rate and calculate target cardiovascular training zone
Administer the sit-and-reach flexibility test according to standardized fitness protocol

topics.topic: Communicable Diseases: Pathogens, Vectors and Prevention
subtopics: Definition and agents of infection: Viruses, bacteria, protozoa, fungi
Vector-borne diseases: Malaria (female Anopheles mosquito), yellow fever, trypanosomiasis
Water-borne and airborne diseases: Cholera, typhoid fever, tuberculosis (transmission, symptoms, and oral rehydration therapy - ORT)
objectives: Diagram the life cycle of the malaria parasite (Plasmodium) in humans and mosquitoes
Prepare homemade Oral Rehydration Salt (ORS) solution using clean water, sugar, and salt
Outline community vector control measures including insecticide-treated nets (ITNs)
